title: Chapter 1869: Broadjade (I)

Chapter 1869: Broadjade (I)

Black and yellow light blazed in Tuoba Qiye's eyes as he stared intently at Gao Fu. Only the crackling of True Fire broke the lengthening silence in the hall.

After a long while, the Bolie King stated calmly, "Fellow Daoist Tuoba, I understand what Lord Yao means by sending you here."

Beside them, Shilou Yingge raised his brows, seemingly suppressing the urge to speak. Tuoba Qiye said softly, "When Wei rose, our two families received their titles together. After Qi fell, our families contended for the realm together as well. Your ancestor Gao Jun was a friend of the late emperor, and a king whom our Liang dynasty recognized as [Keeper of Wei's Ancestral Rites]... Though disagreements arose later, our families have shared a long history.

"This has gone beyond our personal friendship. It concerns the bond between our families... The King of Wei's affairs are now beyond the Gao Family's power to meddle in!"

Tuoba Qiye looked somewhat anxious as he finished, "Moongaze Lake saved the Li Family and remains their protection. Yet in the end, it will also be their death warrant... If the Gao Family becomes entangled in this, disaster will surely follow!"

Gao Fu's expression remained entirely calm as he replied, "Thank you for the warning, fellow Daoist."

Tuoba Qiye turned away. He nearly spoke several times, but this was another family's affair, and he ultimately held his tongue. After a long moment, he said, "In that case... I shall take my leave."

The King of Dai's own brother, a Grand Daoist Master of the Tuoba Family, hurried out of the hall without another word. Shilou Yingge escorted him out and spoke only when they reached the entrance.

"Thank you for your trouble, uncle."

Tuoba Qiye's words in the hall had evidently eased some of his wariness. Looking troubled, Shilou Yingge said, "This matter... is not a question of right or wrong. Please don't take offense."

Tuoba Qiye turned back, a trace of sorrow entering his black-and-yellow eyes. "What reason do I have to take offense? I cannot say he is wrong... After all..."

He paused, then said, "If it comes down to only one of you surviving, you or Ci'er[1], it will certainly be you, Shilou Yingge!"

Shilou Yingge fell silent for a long while before replying, "That may not be a good thing."

Tuoba Qiye gave no reply and silently rode away on the wind. Even though it was his own son who would be sacrificed, his grief did not weaken his resolve. Even the Tuoba Family of old could not afford to offend Mount Luoxia. How could they now?

As long as my elder brother and the young master's plans succeed... Ci'er will have to bear the sacrifice!

As he vanished on the wind, Shilou Yingge returned to the fiery hall, weighed down by his thoughts. Dark-red flames flickered over Gao Fu. Lowering his eyes, Shilou Yingge walked forward.

He asked, "Your majesty... Whom will you send to oppose Wei?"

Gao Fu did not look at him. Instead, he quietly watched the light beyond the successive palace halls. "Yingge, you must resent me too."

Shilou Yingge raised his brows and smiled. "You are the Bolie King and head of the Gao Family. The decisions are yours to make, and mine only to obey... But I must consider how our family is to survive. You have convictions for which you are willing to die, and I have my own wish to preserve the clan. Resenting our superiors... is not the Gao Family's way."

He offered no further explanation, merely smiling. "Please allow me to fulfill that wish, your majesty!"

Gao Fu gave him a long look. In the end, he offered no words of dissuasion. "Go..."

Shilou Yingge's expression was unreadable as he bowed and withdrew. The flame-filled palace grew quieter still. Gao Fu, the Bolie King, stood in the hall, silently watching the bright daylight beyond the successive palace buildings.

—————

Darkness stirred in the night.

The sea lay silent, without a glimmer of light or a ripple, submerged in thick darkness. After an unknown stretch of time, a gleam of heavenly light finally drifted to a halt above the water.

Li Ximing gazed down at the sea, his eyes bright. "Inferior Water... formidable indeed."

They had only ventured a short distance into the sea, yet he could already sense that Inferior Water's mystics here would make riding the wind difficult for Qi Cultivation Realm cultivators. Without a Mansion Water dharma artifact, even a Foundation Establishment Realm cultivator could hardly be certain of crossing fifty kilometers.

Beside him, Daoist Master Baoxiang shook her head slightly. "This is far from the worst of it. Farther west lies a strait called the Abyss of Inferior Water. Even a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator can fall into it with a moment's carelessness."

Li Ximing asked curiously, "Does the sea end beyond the Abyss of Inferior Water?"

Daoist Master Baoxiang smiled and nodded. "This is nothing like the Eastern Sea, with its vast outer seas. Continue west from the Abyss of Inferior Water, and five hundred kilometers farther on, the sea ends."

As they pressed onward, an immense mountain range soon rose into view above the sea. Its ridges wound and undulated through the haze, sharply etched into the mist. The surrounding water lay perfectly still, like a clear mirror.

Daoist Master Baoxiang gestured toward it. "This is [Lesser Broadjade Mountain]."

Li Ximing had heard of the mountain. The [Wondrous Wisdom Tendril] he had obtained from Liu Changdie years ago was one of its treasures. Counting on his fingers, he asked in surprise, "[Gathering Wood]?"

Daoist Master Baoxiang nodded with a smile. "This mountain was formed from a devil's body... The Eastern Sea has [Splitreed Island], and the Western Sea has [Lesser Broadjade Mountain]! However, this region cannot compare with the Eastern Sea's plentiful resources and numerous cultivators. Nor can just anyone ascend this mountain. Anyone capable of remaining here must be at least in the Foundation Establishment Realm."

Her expression grew serious. "After all, this is where one of the earliest Devil Monarchs of [Gathering Wood] was slain. Who knows how many treasures have been nourished here over a thousand years... Senior Yuanxiu cultivated here for quite a number of years!"

"Yuanxiu?"

Li Ximing had not expected to hear that name and fell into thought. Daoist Master Baoxiang glanced around before speaking softly. "He had close ties with [Mercury Circulation Terrace]. Its current master is a dear friend of mine. I heard that Daoist Master Yuanxiu once came here long ago to discuss his path with Grand Daoist Master Miaoqi...

"The Grand Daoist Master tried to dissuade him, saying his method of attaining the Dao was too dangerous. Daoist Master Yuanxiu disagreed, saying, 'Heaven gives birth to the Great Daos and later cultivators follow it. What intercalation is without peril? What succession is without danger?'"

Li Ximing merely said, "I've heard many people praise him. He must have been only a hair's breadth away."

Daoist Master Baoxiang smiled. "You judge correctly, senior. Though the old Daoist Master Yuanxiu had little reputation for combat, his Dao conduct was of the highest order."

Li Ximing keenly noticed that she seemed unusually well informed about Jiangnan and quietly took note. He lowered his head in thought, but the mention of Grand Daoist Master Miaoqi had piqued his interest.

Looking up, he asked, "This Grand Daoist Master Miaoqi... Did he cultivate [Whole Pill]? What realm has he reached now?"

Daoist Master Baoxiang's expression changed, conflicting emotions briefly crossing her face. Lowering her head, she replied, "He passed away long ago."

Somewhat surprised, Li Ximing asked thoughtfully, "What happened..."

As they drew closer to the mountain, their connection to the great void rapidly weakened. Baoxiang grew a little bolder and sneered. "Who else could it be? Who else treats [Whole Pill] as his exclusive preserve? Wasn't there already a Daoist Master from the Helian Family before him? There may be no traces left, but it isn't hard to guess!"

Li Ximing felt a jolt of alarm, followed by worry. He nodded silently and looked down at the mountains below, where rich colors overlapped in layer upon layer.

Baoxiang quickly dropped the subject. "Here we are at [Lesser Broadjade Mountain]."

Li Ximing surveyed the surrounding waters. There was indeed only a single mountainous island. Seeing the thick fog blanketing its slopes, he thought of something and asked, "

Oh?

Senior Liu once gave me a spirit material gathered from this mountain. But why is everything here so shrouded and indistinct..."

Baoxiang replied quietly, "[Mansion Water] brings abundance to lakes and marshes, while [Gathering Wood] embodies mutual shelter and a place to dwell. Wood in water should be nourished by it, but this wood is dead. Thus, instead of nourishing it, the water causes it to decay, producing [Great Undercurrent Decay Qi]. It is even more formidable than the winds of the [Great Western Plains] and can obscure spiritual sense.

"There are plenty of spirit items on the mountain, and occasionally even Purple Mansion Realm spirit materials. They are difficult to find, so one must rely on divination. Every year, however, on the fourteenth day of the seventh month, the mountain's mist eases somewhat. Even Qi Cultivation Realm cultivators can enter then, so the various sects send their disciples inside."

Baoxiang wore a cold smile. "I hardly need to explain further. This business of the fourteenth day of the seventh month is simply several Purple Mansion Realm cultivators joining forces to suppress the [Great Undercurrent Decay Qi]. The disciples then pay for it with their lives. As if anyone truly meant to let them have anything worthwhile."

1. Referring to Tuoba Ci. ☜
